long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in Malmö's Rosengård district by a Bosnian father and Croatian mother, Ibrahimović entered local youth football before joining Malmö FF. His move to Ajax began a career across Juventus, Inter, Barcelona, AC Milan, Paris Saint-Germain, Manchester United and LA Galaxy. A commanding striker known for improvisational goals, he finished with 62 goals in 122 appearances for Sweden and 34 club trophies.

Playing success also created a commercial platform of sponsorships, publishing and personal ventures. After retiring in 2023, Ibrahimović joined RedBird as an operating partner focused on sports, media and entertainment investments. He also became a senior adviser to AC Milan ownership, applying his experience to player development, performance, brand strategy and club projects.

A commanding striker known for improvisational goals, he finished with 62 goals in 122 appearances for Sweden and 34 club trophies.

Playing success also created a commercial platform of sponsorships, publishing and personal ventures. After retiring in 2023, Ibrahimović joined RedBird as an operating partner focused on sports, media and entertainment investments. He also became a senior adviser to AC Milan ownership, applying his experience to player development, performance, brand strategy and club projects.

Self-made reflects a career developed from Rosengård youth football into elite professional contracts and endorsements, with Forbes identifying Soccer as the source of wealth. Public sources do not disclose a complete personal balance sheet or early family resources, so the dossier does not assert the independent-start subtype.

The ontology has no professional-earner or athlete-brand-principal value. It does not imply that he owns RedBird or AC Milan.
